subject: Creating a "second stage" mediated moderation model in lavaan with multigroup comaparison

messages.author: 4dd351618d1950c0
messages.subject: Creating a "second stage" mediated moderation model in lavaan with multigroup comaparison
parts:
Hi everyone,

I will run a moderated mediation analysis (Hayes, model 15) and compare the model between two groups for my PhD.

I run the following code, however, I could not see the index of modmed. Also, I'm not sure if the code is useful for my model since I'm a newbie in R. I read the document in the link Chapter 15: Moderated Mediation. Before running the analysis, I calculate centered score for IV, MOD and MED, then create interaction term for IV:MOD and MED:MOD. In structural model, I added these interaction terms directly, and used centered variables, except DV. All my variables are continues. Besides, I import my data via "haveen" button, not the code. My data set name is "IntOrnek" and grouping variable is "country" coded as 1, 2. In sum, is there anyone who can help me writing the correct code? I found another package useful for moderated mediation however I'm not sure if I can run multigroup SEM in that packages.
Lastly, I run the code, got the output, there is no index of modmed and direct, indirect, total and proportion of mediation 

I would be grateful if anyone could help me. 

Thanks in advance


library(lavaan)

> Model15 <- '
MED ~ a1*IV
 DV ~ cdash1*IV + cdash2*MOD + cdash3*MOD:IV + b1*MED  + b2*MOD:MED  '
   
# MOD   ~  MOD .mean*1
MOD   ~  MOD .mean * 1

# MOD ~~ MOD .var*MOD
MOD ~ ~ MOD .var*MOD

# Indirect effects conditional on moderator
indirect.SDbelow =~ (a1 + a3*( MOD .mean-sqrt( MOD.var))) * b1
indirect.SDabove =~ (a1 + a3*( MOD.mean+sqrt(MOD.var))) * b1


# Direct effects conditional on moderator
direct.SDbelow =~  cdash1 + cdash3*( MOD.mean-sqrt(MOD.var))
direct.SDabove =~  cdash1 + cdash3*( MOD.mean+sqrt(MOD.var))

# Total effects conditional on moderator
total.SDbelow =~  direct.SDbelow + indirect.SDbelow
total.SDabove =~  direct.SDabove + indirect.SDabove

# Proportion mediated conditional on moderator
prop.mediated.SDbelow =~  indirect.SDbelow / total.SDbelow
prop.mediated.SDabove =~  indirect.SDabove / total.SDabove

## Ensure country variable is character
IntOrnek$country <- as.character(IntOrnek$country)  # Add this line


# Fit the multigroup model
Model15Sem <- sem(Model15, data = IntOrnek, estimator = "MLR", missing = "ML", group = "country")

Model15Sem.constrained <- sem(Model15, data =  IntOrnek, estimator = "MLR", missing = "ML", group = "country", group.equal = c("regressions"))

summary(Model15Sem, modindices = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Creating a "second stage" mediated moderation model in lavaan with multigroup comaparison
parts:
All the lines that define new parameters should be included in the model syntax. From the message, it seems that the model syntax end at " b2*MOD:MED", with a single quote at the end of that line.

Moreover, for lines like the following ones, I believe you mean ":=", not "=~".
indirect.SDbelow =~ (a1 + a3*( MOD .mean-sqrt( MOD.var))) * b1

You can see an example here:

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/mediation.html

You may encounter other issues when you ask for standardized solution. The following thread is not about mediation, but the same issue may occur in some models with indirect effects.

https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/AWGORQnmKBg/m/ZohckNBFAQAJ

But the problems with the model syntax should be fixed first.

Hope this helps.

-- Shu Fai
